title: Target Building Point From w And The Depth-Zero Point
body_html:
Target Building Point From w And The Depth-Zero Point

Assume $w\in W$ satisfies

$$ M(w)=\beta. $$

Let $\bar x'$ be a point in $B(Z_{G'})$, where $Z_{G'}$ is the depth-zero centralizer block attached to $(wV)^\perp$ in the draft notation.

The theta draft defines a point

$$ x'(w,\bar x')\in B(G') $$

inductively by:

$$ x'(0,\bar x'):=\bar x', $$

and, after splitting off the largest brick,

$$ x'(w,\bar x')=(x'_b,x'_a(w_a,\bar x')). $$

The top-brick component $x'_b$ is characterized by the lattice identity

$$ \mathcal L'_{x'_b,t} = w\,\mathcal L_{x_b,t+s_b}. $$

Draft Caution

The TeX uses block notation $\mathfrak b,\mathfrak a$ and leaves the precise typing of the depth-zero block implicit. This node should be refined once the pre-SSC definition is stabilized.
